response.text:
**Checkpoint verdict: two concrete implementation blockers remain. Geometry113 is not ready for acceptance.** I reviewed commit `0dc1239bc6620c76a4465b4cc5ab4d9ebecc30df` and its retained development packet.

1. **Tactical discovery generates the wrong coordinates.**  
   [`DiscoverTacticalMovementCommands`](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/0dc1239bc6620c76a4465b4cc5ab4d9ebecc30df/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/SharedWorldCommandQueries.cs#L563) puts relative offsets `−1..1` into command X/Y, but [`AssessTacticalMovementCommand`](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/0dc1239bc6620c76a4465b4cc5ab4d9ebecc30df/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/TacticalMovementPolicy.cs#L145) interprets them as absolute destinations.

   The retained r237 view places the acting hero at `(5,3)`. Every generated destination is therefore nonadjacent. The campaign succeeds because it supplies explicit absolute destinations.

   For the new profile, generate checked `actor.X + dx` and `actor.Y + dy`, retaining deterministic option ordering and older-profile behavior. Add actual acting-hero discovery checks beyond x4: valid and blocked destinations, weighted costs, unchanged state around queries, restore parity, and successful execution of a discovered option. Existing companion-only discovery comparisons miss this defect.

2. **Run/resume queries omit the existing Strain Dash lock.**  
   [`AssessWorldStep` and `AssessTraversalControl`](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/0dc1239bc6620c76a4465b4cc5ab4d9ebecc30df/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/SharedWorldCommandQueries.cs#L104) check Action and condition eligibility, but omit `ExpeditionStrainRules.DashLocked`. Actual [`PayRun`/`PayActivityDash`](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/0dc1239bc6620c76a4465b4cc5ab4d9ebecc30df/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/TestOnlySharedWorldPolicy.cs#L409) enforce it.

   At Strain3/4, a run paid late in an ordinary interval creates a six-second lock extending beyond the next regular Start. After that Start refreshes Action/movement, an otherwise legal new run or running resume can query as available while execution rejects it.

   Share the applicable read-only Dash admission between query and payment. Preserve already-paid same-interval reuse. Require a genuine control crossing the actual Start, unchanged query/execution denial while locked, and admission at exact expiry. The retained genesis Dash control exercises Strain0.

These are **source-derived findings**, not runtime reproductions I executed.

The central geometry implementation otherwise appears consistent in the reviewed scope: one canonical observation map, immutable trusted terrain binding, no malformed-profile fallback, shared ordinary/tactical destination costs, complete113 inheritance of112/base90, and exact policy binding during restoration. Controller changes use declared static geometry without adding private occupancy pruning. The retained exclusion probes support their configuration/dispatch boundaries; they do not establish played Push, route, camp or trap behavior.

One additional **evidence binding gap** needs closing: `Open-ConnectedExpedition.ps1` is committed and inspected, but neither the457 compilation hashes nor955 static hashes includes it, and I found no execution-time host hash in the retained JSON. Bind the actual console host and relevant driver bytes used by qualification, as previously agreed.

My independent checks were:

- Verified both archive hashes/sizes and **every indexed member:147 development artifacts and four DLLs**.
- Compared all **457 compilation-input hashes and955 static-input hashes** with the exact committed export.
- Reconciled focused report/build-report/DLL hashes and inspected all five reported case outcomes.
- Inspected the retained r237–327 movement, OA/Press/nested-response, closure and fractional-travel records, plus the457-command/21-save inherited-route report.
- Reviewed source, tests, persistence, host exposure, authority/payload filtering, consumer boundaries and retention/launch scripts.

I **did not** compile C#, execute gameplay or restoration, observe workers, or verify live regression journals.

Correcting these blockers requires a new source freeze and qualification against those corrected binaries. Preserve run `062fe06abe744b759b4b67943e0d9221` with its actual disposition; its results cannot qualify changed binaries. Full regression, five-path/public parity, authentic95–112 continuations, forgery/backup controls and actual final review remain mandatory. TAC-10 remains at the subsequent amended-contract gate; Unity remains deferred and storage/Support held.
